0.0: Did you go speak to #p2140003#? He records all of Maple World's history. The only things he doesn't know are things that have yet to occur. He probably answered all your questions before you even asked. So, what did you say? \r\n#L0# #b(I relayed what #p2140003# said.)
0.1: Hmm, he must have held back the exact reasons because he is bound not to reveal the secrets of history. But I'm sure he's telling the truth. Then the Goddess' promise isn't the problem... \r\n#L0# #bSo what's blocking me then?
0.2: You already passed the test. You were given permission. Your oblivion is still intact. The fact that you meet all the qualifications but still can't enter... can only mean one thing! It means there is an outside force that has infiltrated the temple!\r\n#L0# #bForce outside the temple?
0.3: An intruder must have gone deep into the temple and put up a force field. That's the only explanation I can think of. What is this intruder planning...? Anyway, the force field needs to be taken down... Oh, you promised to help with this mystery anyway, right?
